title: Hermes Agent: Autonomous Creative Workflow System
summary: An open-source autonomous agent framework by NousResearch designed for complex task orchestration. It features deep integration with ComfyUI, enabling natural language control over node-based image and video generation workflows.
research_notes: The system includes automated hardware checks and self-healing dependency management for complex ComfyUI custom nodes.

evolution.summary: The project transitioned from a modular skill-based harness into a bundled-by-default autonomous platform. The latest updates introduced Kanban-style multi-agent orchestration and persistent goal tracking across sessions.
